scope: FieldLog Android startup diagnosis using a foreground private ADB server and an inert owned TCP peer.

containment.inertControl: Allowlisted peer received the control payload. The sandbox denied the unlisted loopback destination and process fork.
containment.client: Direct bounded smart-socket requests to the verified listener, with no ADB client process or auto-start.

preflights.result: Sandbox rejected numeric 127.0.0.1 in its address filter. The foreground ADB server did not start.

The positive control assumed ECONNREFUSED on a bound port without a listener and observed EAGAIN. The foreground ADB server did not start. The succeeding control used an owned listening peer and verified delivery.

cleanup.groupAbsenceObservation: killpg(pgid, 0) returned ESRCH after direct child reap

conclusion: A five-second connect deadline can expire after TCP accept while the private ADB server stays responsive and the exact transport remains offline. Which stage the held emulator reached is unknown.
nextOwnedBoot: Verify the fresh port-only server listener belongs to the foreground PID and obtain a bounded host:version reply before launching the disposable API 36 emulator.

Use fresh assigned ports. Wait for the emulator-owned loopback transport listener before connecting once. Record exact-target state separately and bound every observation. An expired client deadline alone does not establish that the server-side connect finished.

After the exact transport reports device, use the canonical bounded sys.boot_completed loop and verify the intended AVD and API level before APK install. Reap each owned group and establish group absence separately.
